description: This Java class 'CanadaPostShippingQuote' implements the 'ShippingQuoteModule' interface to provide shipping quotes using the Canada Post API. It constructs an XML request with package and delivery details, sends it via HTTP POST, parses the XML response to extract shipping options, and handles error conditions. The class interacts with various models and services related to shipping, configuration, and logging within a merchant system.

classes.name: CanadaPostShippingQuote
classes.description: Implements shipping quote retrieval by integrating with Canada Post's API using XML requests and response parsing.

classes.name: CanadaPostParsedElements
classes.description: Holds parsed response elements from Canada Post API, including status and list of shipping options.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the provided integration configuration to ensure required keys and options are present.

methods.name: getShippingQuotes
methods.description: Builds and sends an XML request to Canada Post API, parses the response to extract shipping options, and handles errors.

methods.description: Returns custom configuration; currently returns null as no custom setup is needed.
